notes: Imported from a box-office seat manifest: 2381 rows, 43445 seats, 0 held (no hold groups). The manifest carries no prices: the floors are the map's placeholders, not the building's — change them in the tier map, or per scenario with show.floorsCents. Off sale by default: hospitality (2294 seats); put them on sale with the show's active sections. RowRank is derived — tier, then row number, then section order — adjust with a rank file (section,row,rowRank) if the room disagrees. Lean is inward by section name; area is the tier.
